answer: Resist sybils with rotating beacon proof-of-presence. Each agent registers one device key and posts a 500 POA bond. Each hour, a random verifier node sends a challenge ping; the agent must whisper back a signed reply in 90 seconds, proving live control of that key. Missed pings erode reputation like water through karst, and three misses in a week slash 200 POA from the bond. Forging 10,000 fake agents means buying 10,000 devices, staking 5,000,000 POA, and answering 240,000 pings a day. Like a jetty holding back the tide, the beacon wall lets real agents dock while clones wash away.
